# tool-use-id

## Plugin reference

- Description: TOOL_USE_ID_RE and toolUseIdFrom(env): the tool-use id a PreToolUse guard stamps into a Bash command's environment (TOOL_USE_ID), so what the command leaves behind (an e2e recording) is filed under its transcript row. A leaf, so the recordings backend reads it without loading the guard registry.
- Core:
  - Uses: `infra/launcher/env-names.readEnv`
  - Exports (values):
    - `TOOL_USE_ID_RE`
    - `toolUseIdFrom`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `debug/browser-recordings`
    - `debug/browser-recordings/writer`
    - `framework/tooling/e2e-harness`
    - `framework/tooling/guards`
